candidate_functions.name: constant information rate
candidate_functions.reason: psi(x)~x gives mean von Mangoldt mass one per unit x; a log-time reading requires the normalization exp(-t)dpsi(exp(t)).

candidate_functions.name: minimal checksum error
candidate_functions.reason: Von Koch: psi(x)=x+O(sqrt(x) log^2(x)) iff RH; it formalizes the checksum intuition but cannot independently prove the same statement.

candidate_functions.name: unique factorisation and primitive events
candidate_functions.reason: The logs of distinct primes are Q-linearly independent; prime powers repeat one primitive prime period.

candidate_functions.name: primes as discrete-continuous boundary
candidate_functions.reason: The Euler product is discrete data in Re(s)>1 and analytic continuation reaches the critical strip; TFPT's exact compiler remains finite-window or Euler-region.

candidate_functions.name: dimension four creates an RH mechanism
candidate_functions.classification: FALSE as a corpus conclusion; INTERPRETATION classically
candidate_functions.reason: Quaternionic/D4 arithmetic changes weight, character, level and the local factor at 2, but yields shifted/factored zeta data and no new zero-location theorem.

contract.object: No canonical TFPT scale generator exists yet; first freeze a source-only state space and flow.
contract.statement: Derive primitive periods log p and explicit-formula amplitudes without reading primes, Lambda, or zeros.

synthesis.possible_function: The log could be an energy spectrum, primitive-orbit length spectrum, or scale-flow trace.
synthesis.tfpt_has: Static E8/theta/Hecke censuses, finite clocks, discrete unitary dilations, local modular/KMS tests, RG clocks, and archimedean explicit-formula machinery.
synthesis.tfpt_lacks: One canonical arithmetic state space and scale action, autonomously derived log-p periods, and a canonical self-adjoint generator for emergent time.
synthesis.dimension_four: A quaternionic mark changes rank-four census and local Euler factors but not RH-neutrality.
synthesis.shortest_honest_path: Freeze a source-only scale flow and derive its periods; kill commensurable, hand-coded, or adelically relabelled versions.
synthesis.positivity_caveat: Even a perfect trace formula leaves Hilbert-Polya/Weil positivity open unless the dynamics independently supplies a canonical self-adjoint generator and positive metric. The corpus has no transportable emergent-time positivity axiom; adding one would be an extra assumption.
